paragraphs.text: Meris was a human from Naktamun on the plane of Amonkhet , and an initiate of Tah crop. He was in love with Imi.

As part of the Tah crop, Meris embarked upon the Trial of Ambition . Although Imi was eaten by flesh-eating scarabs, Meris made it to the last chamber, overseen by Bontu herself. He did not survive the last culling, however, and his heart was claimed by Djeru , who was one of four crop members to complete the trial.
